name: DEAD INSIDE
detailed_description:
Yumeko is discharged from the hospital after a long period of treatment. She feels weak and exhausted, but is determined to start a new life.

One day she discovers that she has a twin sister, and from that moment on, her life will never be the same again.

DEAD INSIDE — is a psychological thriller visual novel.

Features

  • Visual Novel, Psychological Thriller
  • High-quality anime-style graphics
  • An anxious dark atmosphere, which will be conveyed to the player through unusual sounds and visual effects
  • Unexpected endings that depend on player choice
